answers.core: It existed previously, but was presumably lost in major refactoring of GDScript-related code in the 3->4 transition (only a guess).
answers.workaround: I believe it would be technically possible to implement this as a plugin (only for auto-completion suggestions) by connecting to the related code completion signals in the editor's CodeEdit node when editing a script, but it would require some degree of parsing on the raw text the completion is being requested for, checking the ProjectSettings to find if such an autoload exists, finding the autoload node in the editor's node tree, and then calling its `get_property_list` method before adding and return the completion options.

title: Re-introduce auto-completion suggestions of properties from `Object.get_property_list` for Autoloads for Godot 4
